final_model.name: XGBoost Tuned & Regularized (125 features, no ethnic)

pilot_design.primary_kpi: Incremental 60-day retention rate (r_treatment - r_control) and Net Retained Margin (MU)

impact.executive_statement: Estimated under stated PoC assumptions (N=100,000, ARPU=58.72 MU, margin=70%, H=6m, V=246.62 MU, save rate s=20%, cost c=8.00 MU): at k=10%, Base net ranges from -38,906 MU (pi_r=2%) to +13,659 MU (pi_r=5%) and +83,276 MU (pi_r=10%; +90,940 MU at k*=15%). The break-even churn prior at k=10% is 4.17%; at pi_r=2%, restricting outreach to Top 1–2% stays positive (k*=1%: +3,590 MU).

levers.driver: mou_ratio_3m & change_mou (Voice Usage Drop vs 3m Avg)
levers.evidence: Perm AUC drop = -29.85e-3 (#1); silent 0 MOU lines churn at 78.5%, missing trend at 76.0%
levers.implied_action: Trigger proactive voice/data bonus or multi-SIM loyalty bundle when active subscriber MOU drops >25% vs 3m avg

levers.evidence: Perm AUC drop = -21.09e-3 (#2); churn jumps from 29.3% (m=9) to 64.6% (m=11)
levers.implied_action: Contact subscribers in months 8-9 in a 50/50 holdout A/B pilot

levers.evidence: Perm AUC drop = -15.68e-3 (#3); +23.83 pp jump past 300d across 19/19 areas
levers.implied_action: Send targeted trade-in/installment upgrade voucher at eqpdays 240-290 in 50/50 holdout A/B

levers.driver: totmrc_Mean, rev_ratio_3m & recurring_share (Tariff Fit & Overage Shock)
levers.evidence: Combined Perm AUC drop = -19.03e-3; high overage raises churn; ASL lowers by -9.5 pp
levers.implied_action: Migrate high-overage accounts to predictable recurring bundles and enable ASL protection
Scale retention offer cost (c) to customer recurring margin (V)
